MonoBrowser 0.6.2

- Compact right-click menu: one narrow column with Back / Forward / Reload icons at the top, thin dividers between groups and keyboard shortcut hints
- The address bar and start page open local and LAN hosts (localhost, *.localhost, 127.x, [::1], private ranges, *.local) over http://
- Experimental: detect web servers running on localhost at startup and offer to open them
- Experimental: accept self-signed certificates on loopback hosts
- Hard reload with Ctrl+Shift+R / Shift+F5, and "Clear site cache and reload" in the page menu and command palette
- Responsive preview in split view (375 / 768 / 1280 px, mobile user agent, follows the source tab)
- Prompts can offer several choices as checkboxes

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.6.2.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.6.2-x86_64.AppImage`
